text.content:
Furies never know when to quit: in battle and life they are energetic, determined and often restless.

SKILLS

BONE CRUSHER · SL max 5

You may use an action and make a melee attack: (MIG + MIG) Check against Armor, or (DEX + MIG) Check if you have a ranged weapon with the two-handed property equipped. This attack deals (SL × 5) extra damage.

ENRAGE · SL max 5

At the start of your turn during a conflict, you may make a (WLP) Check against your own Magic Defense. On a failure, you become enraged. While enraged, your melee attacks deal 5 extra damage and have Weakness against all sources. On your turn, you may spend 20 Mind Points to end enraged.

BATTLE RHYTHM · SL max 3

When an enemy you can see hits or misses you with an attack, you gain stacking bonuses until the end of the scene: +1 to hit and damage with your attacks, and +1 to your Armor.

RAISE HELL · SL max 2

When you use an action or a reaction, other creatures within 3 squares of you gain Weakness until the end of the scene. This effect is cumulative.

UP CLOSE AND PERSONAL · SL max 2

When an enemy within 2 squares of you uses a ranged attack, you may move up to 2 squares towards them and perform a free melee attack.
